set_brightness.docs: This action allows you to dynamically change the brightness of the display at runtime.

a_pin.docs:
Row address bit 0.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

b1_pin.docs:
Blue data pin for top half.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

b2_pin.docs:
Blue data pin for bottom half.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

b_pin.docs:
Row address bit 1.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

bit_depth.docs:
**int**: Color bit depth (4-12). Higher values = better color accuracy but slower refresh. Defaults to `8`.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

board.docs:
**string**: Board preset name. One of: `adafruit-matrix-portal-s3`, `apollo-automation-m1-rev4`, `apollo-automation-m1-rev6`, `huidu-hd-wf2`. When specified, automatically configures all pin mappings.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

brightness.docs:
**int**: Initial brightness level (0-255). Defaults to `128`.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

c_pin.docs:
Row address bit 2.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

clk_pin.docs:
Clock pin.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

clock_phase.docs:
**boolean**: Invert clock phase. Defaults to `false`. Required to be `true` for MBI5124 driver.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

clock_speed.docs:
**enum**: Output clock speed. Defaults to `20MHZ`. One of:

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

d_pin.docs:
Row address bit 3.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

double_buffer.docs:
**boolean**: Enable double buffering to prevent tearing. Defaults to `false`. Set to `false` when using LVGL.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

e_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Row address bit 4. Required for 1/32 scan panels (32+ rows), omit for 1/16 scan panels.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

g1_pin.docs:
Green data pin for top half.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

g2_pin.docs:
Green data pin for bottom half.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

CIE1931.docs: CIE 1931 perceptual curve (recommended for most displays)

gamma_correct.docs:
**enum**: Gamma correction mode. One of:

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

lat_pin.docs:
Latch/strobe pin.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

latch_blanking.docs:
**int**: Number of clock cycles OE is blanked during LAT pulse. Defaults to `1`.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

layout.docs:
**enum**: Physical panel chaining pattern. Defaults to `HORIZONTAL`. One of:

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

layout_cols.docs:
**int**: Number of panels arranged horizontally. Defaults to `1`.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

layout_rows.docs:
**int**: Number of panels arranged vertically. Defaults to `1`.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

min_refresh_rate.docs:
**int**: Minimum panel refresh rate in Hz (40-200). The panel may refresh faster than this, but won't go slower. Auto-calculated from `update_interval` (defaults to 60 Hz when `update_interval: never`). Rarely needs to be set manually.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

oe_pin.docs:
Output enable pin.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

panel_height.docs:
**int**: Height of a single panel in pixels (e.g., `32`).

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

panel_width.docs:
**int**: Width of a single panel in pixels (e.g., `64`).

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

r1_pin.docs:
Red data pin for top half.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

r2_pin.docs:
Red data pin for bottom half.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

scan_wiring.docs:
**enum**: Panel scan wiring pattern. Defaults to `STANDARD_TWO_SCAN`. One of:

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

shift_driver.docs:
**enum**: LED shift register driver chip type. Defaults to `GENERIC`. One of:

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: Display update frequency. Defaults to `16ms` (~60 FPS). Set to `never` when using LVGL.

*See also: [HUB75 RGB LED Matrix Display](https://esphome.io/components/display/hub75#configuration-variables)*
